entries.title: Outer and inner gunghap
entries.content: Outer gunghap compares birth years and animals. Inner gunghap compares day and hour pillars and is considered the deeper match.
entries.source: Gunghap: Understanding Korean Marital Compatibility & Saju
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Balance, not sameness
entries.content: Gunghap looks for charts that balance each other, such as a 'cold' Metal-Water chart paired with a 'warm' Wood-Fire chart. Opposites are not read as a bad sign.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: A conversation starter
entries.content: Many young Koreans use gunghap to talk about differences and how they communicate. Friction is treated as something to understand, not a verdict.
entries.source: Gunghap: Understanding Korean Marital Compatibility & Saju
entries.label: Cultural practice
